title: Solr Engineer
description:
Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Software Engineer required
  • Experience deploying software to the public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Have prior hands-on software development experience (Java/AWS preferred)
  • Experience modernizing large-scale search systems
  • 3+ years working with SOLR


Responsibilites:

  • Lead the transition from legacy SOLR infrastructure to modern, semantic, and hybrid search solutions leveraging AWS. Drive roadmap planning in collaboration with product and ML leadership.
  • Developing Search Algorithms: Implementing advanced search algorithms that can process large datasets quickly and accurately, leveraging search engine features such as vector
  • Performance Tuning: Continuously testing and optimizing the performance of the search engine to improve query response times, accuracy, and relevancy based on defined metrics
  • Collaborate with your Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and UX to make sure requirements are clear and we’re taking the best technical approaches.
  • Work in a collaborative team environment with a focus on continuous improvement and learning.



Day to Day:

We are looking for a Solr/Search Engineer to join the Search Engine team. Our team is comprised of varying levels of experience and backgrounds. As a Lead Search Engineer in one of our search teams, you can expect to work with other Software Engineers, Architects and Analysts to develop products and deliver solutions in a cloud environment and working with Technical Product Managers by helping with the execution of product roadmaps and backlog priorities. As data volumes grow and user queries become more complex, we need someone with deep expertise in search technologies like Elasticsearch, Apache SOLR, or Lucene to push our infrastructure to the next level.

title: Logistics and Supply Chain Specialist
description:
MetaFLO operates within the waste industry, providing innovative solutions for liquid waste

management. We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized logistics coordinator to join our team. In

this role, you will be responsible for managing orders, ensuring all shipments are handled efficiently and

accurately. The ideal candidate will have experience in logistics, strong business communication skills

and the ability to work in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.


Main Responsibilities


  • Receive and process customer orders, prepare and submit purchase orders (POs), and arrange shipments
  • Manage logistics and shipment arrangement to streamline operations
  • Prepare and provide quotations for clients, including verifying transportation rates and scheduling
  • Coordinate cross-border and international shipments, ensuring all necessary customs and shipping documents are prepared
  • Track and manage order status, ensuring accurate and timely delivery
  • Organize and distribute product samples to clients upon request
  • Maintain and build strong relationships with vendors to ensure smooth operations
  • Identify and source new logistics partners to optimize shipping costs, delivery times, and service quality
  • Collaborate with the operations manager and other internal teams to ensure seamless order fulfillment


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in logistics and shipment coordination, with a strong understanding of preparing necessary shipping and customs documents
  • Strong business communication skills, with the ability to deliver precise shipment statuses and understand customers' needs
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple orders and shipments simultaneously
  • Self-discipline and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
  • Problem-solving mindset


Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English

title: SR Python Engineer + Java
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients.


We are looking for a strong SR Python Engineer with Java and AI Integration exp, with the next qualifications:


  • Python (advanced): 80% of the work involves backend/API development.
  • NoSQL databases: experience with MongoDB or similar is required.
  • Search engine: experience with Elasticsearch (or OpenSearch / Solr) is highly valued.
  • AWS Cloud : DynamoDB and other AWS services, plus experience with containers (Docker, ECS, or EKS).
  • Java: solid understanding of Core Java (version 11 preferred).
  • Version control & CI/CD: GitHub and Jenkins (basic working knowledge is sufficient).
  • Familiarity with Python-based AI integrations or real-time AI products.


Experience: 6–8 years

  • English Level: Advanced (C1)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Python Backend Engineer who’s passionate about building scalable, high-performance systems in the cloud.

This is a hands-on development role, you’ll be designing APIs, adding new product features, and helping integrate AI functionalities into production systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python (core focus).
  • Develop new features and enhance existing ones across a large-scale cloud platform.
  • Work on AI-driven functionality, connecting data and services through Python integrations.
  • Contribute to a robust cloud infrastructure on AWS, using containers and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and high reliability.


Want to change the world? Let us know.

  • Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

description:
A Insightful Consulting é uma empresa de tecnologia que transforma ideias em soluções digitais até 10x mais rápido com o poder do low-code Mendix da Siemens.

Ajudamos empresas a acelerar sua jornada de inovação, unindo agilidade, escalabilidade e governança em um só ambiente.


Aqui, você vai trabalhar com tecnologia de ponta, IA e low-code para gerar impacto real nos negócios e construir o futuro digital das empresas.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer | Vue3 + C#
description:
About the Role  


We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in Vue3 , .NET Core , and AWS to join a global engineering team building real-time, data-intensive platforms. This role involves owning both the UI and backend layers of mission-critical systems that demand exceptional performance, scalability, and reliability. 


You’ll work alongside highly skilled engineers, contributing to the architecture, development, and deployment of modern applications in a distributed environment. 




Key Responsibilities  


  • Design, develop, and maintain Vue3-based frontends using the Composition API, Pinia, TypeScript, and Vite. 
  • Contribute to .NET Core APIs and microservices , integrating complex business logic and data flows. 
  • Deploy, scale, and monitor applications on AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch). 
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated testing workflows. 
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers in an Agile environment. 
  • Participate in architecture reviews and propose performance optimizations for low-latency systems. 
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following software engineering best practices. 


Technical Environment  


  • Frontend: Vue3 (Composition API, Pinia, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Storybook, Cypress, Jest) 
  • Backend: C# / .NET Core, Entity Framework, REST & WebSocket APIs, async programming 
  • Cloud: AWS (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, RDS, CloudWatch) 
  • DevOps: GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI/CD 
  • Testing & Observability: Unit, Integration, and E2E testing; Logging and Monitoring (OpenTelemetry) 


Requirements  


  • 7+ years of professional software development experience 
  • 3+ years of production experience with Vue3 (Composition API + Pinia)  
  • 2+ years working hands-on with AWS deployments (Lambda, ECS, or similar) 
  • Strong backend experience with .NET Core APIs and microservice design 
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines , testing frameworks, and code quality tools 
  • Excellent communication skills in English (B2 or higher)  
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in distributed teams 


Nice to Have  


  • Experience with real-time or data-heavy applications (trading, analytics, monitoring systems) 
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ) 
  • Knowledge of TypeScript performance optimization and UI rendering strategies 
  • Exposure to financial systems or enterprise-grade environments  


What We Offer  


  • 100% remote work with a globally distributed engineering team 
  • Competitive compensation in USD 
  • Long-term contract with opportunities for professional growth 
  • Collaborative, high-performance environment with strong engineering culture 
  • Projects that challenge your technical skills and reward innovation

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Company Description

LAB Tech Analytics is a dynamic and forward-thinking small company dedicated to revolutionizing data-driven solutions. We empower businesses to unlock the true potential of their data assets with our comprehensive suite of services. From our top-notch data recruitment and training hub to our cutting-edge data products and services, we provide end-to-end solutions for every stage of the data lifecycle. Our expert team combines technical excellence with deep industry knowledge to deliver actionable insights, advanced analytics, robust data infrastructure, and strategic guidance.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Software Engineer Intern. The Software Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining software applications, assisting in the design and implementation of new features, and collaborating with the engineering team to improve existing systems. The intern will also participate in code reviews, write clear and efficient code, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.


Qualifications

  • Experience in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++)
  • Understanding of software development methodologies and tools
  • Interest in learning and both front-end and back-end development
  • Familiarity with databases and data structures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with data analytics and machine learning is a plus

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)


About the Role:


We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our remote team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will transform raw data into actionable insights, support data-driven decision-making, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve business outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends and patterns.
  • Create dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to define metrics and KPIs.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic decisions.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across systems.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
  • Strong skills in SQL and proficiency in Python or R.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; proficiency in English is a plus.


Benefits:

  • 100% remote work from anywhere in Latin America.
  • Flexible schedule and collaborative environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Node/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


The Ideal Candidate:

Along with our partner, we are seeking a self-driven engineer  who's passionate about using technology to improve healthcare outcomes, and who embodies the values described above.

You’re not just here to write code—you’re here to make things better. You take real ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the impact of your work. Instead of just “closing tickets,” you ask questions, challenge assumptions, and look for smarter ways to solve problems  that matter. You connect what you build to business outcomes —like improving patient care, speeding up clinical workflows, or scaling global access to healthcare. You love diving into the unknown, learning fast, and collaborating as an equal partner across design, product, and AI teams. If you get energy from ownership, curiosity, and building for impact, you’ll feel right at home here.


What You'll Work On:

  • AI-Powered Healthcare Products:  You will build and scale their AI symptom checker (10M+ MAU in US/Japan), Doctor's Note, Checkup monitoring tools, and LLM-powered services for both consumers and healthcare providers.
  • Healthcare SaaS for HCPs:  Design and launch new SaaS products for healthcare providers (HCPs), enabling improved clinical workflows, patient data insights, and AI-assisted decision support.
  • LLM-Native Environment:  Operate in an LLM-native product environment, where LLMs are deeply integrated across consumer- and provider-facing products as well as into the development process itself (AI-assisted coding, automated testing, knowledge retrieval, and experimentation).
  • Full-Stack & LLM Development:  Work across frontend (React, Next.js, React Native), backend (Node.js, TypeScript), and infrastructure layers while integrating LLM capabilities (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, LangChain/LangGraph orchestration) into user-facing applications.
  • Data-Driven Solutions:  Contribute to data analysis initiatives that directly impact user experience, health outcomes, and provider efficiency by leveraging structured (EHR/claims) and unstructured (clinical notes, patient conversations) data.
  • Global Impact:  Develop products that guide millions of users to appropriate healthcare worldwide, while building provider-first solutions that scale across different healthcare systems.


What We're Looking For:

Technical Requirements (Must-Have)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Full-stack expertise across all layers:
  • Frontend: React, Next.js
  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript
  • Database: SQL
  • Data analysis experience - ability to derive insights from user data and metrics
  • Experience building scalable web applications in fast-paced environments
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to code quality
  • Business-level or higher English proficiency
  • At least 4 hours of overlap with NYC time zone (9am-5pm EST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup environment
  • SaaS product development experience
  • Experience with AI or LLM-powered product development
  • Healthcare industry experience
  • Experience with global, cross-cultural teams


Our Culture

  • Adaptable:  We thrive in change—experiment quickly, learn constantly, and keep improving.
  • Impact-Oriented:  We focus on work that drives measurable value for users and the business.
  • Ownership-Minded:  We take initiative, think end-to-end, and deeply care about solving real user problems.
  • Humble:  We put mission over ego, embrace feedback, and celebrate shared success.
  • Curious:  We question assumptions, explore bold ideas, and never stop learning.
  • Collaborative:  We build trust through open, candid, and respectful communication.


What Makes This Role Special:

  • Autonomous Organization: Our partner applies Holacracy - no traditional management hierarchy
  • Global Impact: Your code will directly impact millions of users' healthcare decisions
  • Partnership with Tech Giants: They partner with Google to enhance AI capabilities
  • Design Partnership: Collaborate with IDEO/D4V for human-centered design
  • Learning Culture: Work with a cross-functional team spanning multiple time zones


Work Style & Culture:

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work directly with designers, product owners, and clinical consultants
  • Data-driven decisions: Regular user interviews and metric-based iterations
  • Fast experimentation: Quick prototype → test → learn cycles
  • Direct communication: Open, honest feedback culture
  • Purpose-driven: Every feature connects to our healthcare mission


Tech Stack Details:

Frontend

  • TypeScript
  • React, Next.js
  • Tailwind.css

Backend

  • TypeScript
  • Nest.js
  • GraphQL, Apollo Federation (APIs)

LLM & AI

  • Large language models (Gemini, Claude, GPT, etc)
  • LangChain/LangGraph (backend)
  • Prompt engineering for healthcare

Database & Data Analysis

  • SQL databases (CloudSQL(Postgres)/Spanner/AlloyDB)
  • Redis
  • BigQuery
  • Data analysis tools and frameworks (LightDash/Looker Studio)

Infrastructure

  • GCP
  • Github Enterprise
  • CI/CD pipelines (Github Action / Cloud Build)
  • Monitoring and observability tools (Sentry)

Development Environment

  • VS Code / Cursor
  • Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex for AI-assisted development
  • Collaborative development tools and pair programming


Think you're a match?

  • You naturally take ownership of problems end-to-end
  • You genuinely care about understanding user needs
  • You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • You want your technical skills to directly impact global health


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a global health-tech leader transforming healthcare through AI-powered solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Project Analyst
description:
SMT is a professional services and intelligence company specializing in technologies that transform how companies engage with their customers, employees, communities, and other stakeholders. Together with its partners, SMT implements the most robust global technologies in Experience Management. In today’s digital environment, experience has become increasingly critical for attracting, retaining, and engaging customers, talent, and influencers. Join our team as a Project Analyst and work on technology projects for global leaders!


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the implementation of the Medallia solution;
  • Training and guiding clients in the use of Medallia services;
  • Configuring and optimizing surveys, dashboards, and automated workflows;
  • Conducting tests to ensure the quality and performance of all deliverables.


What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory;
  • Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn;
  • Passion for data, technology, and user experience;
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with diverse audiences.


What we offer:

  • 100% remote work with flexible hours;
  • CLT contract;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Life insurance;
  • Flash card (meal & food allowance);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Financial support for psychotherapy;
  • Access to learning and training platforms;
  • Annual bonus based on performance.


Note: Candidates must be fluent in English; those who are not will be disqualified automatically.

title: QA Engineer – AI-Powered Test Automation - Remote
description:
QA Engineer – AI-Powered Test Automation - Remote


Job Link:


Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test suites for full-stack .NET applications using AI-assisted tools;
  • Leverage AI tools (TestRigor, Mabl, GitHub Copilot, including Copilot for Test Automation, etc.) to accelerate test creation and execution;
  • Implement functional, integration, regression, and performance tests to ensure application quality and scalability;
  • Work alongside developers using AI-generated code to validate functionalities and ensure software quality;
  • Participate in code reviews and agile ceremonies (sprints, daily stand-ups, retrospectives);
  • Design and execute continuous testing strategies in CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar);
  • Monitor test execution and analyze AI-generated results to quickly identify and resolve issues;
  • Promote a “shift-left” culture to ensure quality from the start of development;
  • Create scripts for load, stress, and security testing to ensure system resilience.

Benefits

  • Work directly with portfolio companies to drive innovation and generate real impact;
  • Leverage cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate full stack development;
  • Be part of a high-performance team within a long-term investment company;
  • Competitive compensation package, benefits, and professional growth opportunities.


Required Knowledge

  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields;
  • Experience in Software Quality Assurance with a focus on automation (minimum of 3 years);
  • At least 6 months of hands-on experience with AI-based QA tools (e.g., TestRigor, Mabl);
  • Strong knowledge of automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, among others;
  • Experience creating automated tests for APIs, databases, and UI;
  • Experience working in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban) and active participation in code reviews;
  • Practical experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines;
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to leverage AI to accelerate test creation and debugging;
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for communication in a global environment.


Desired Knowledge

  • Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, k6, or similar);
  • Experience with security testing tools.


Skills

  • Critical thinking and attention to detail;
  • Proactivity in identifying and solving failures;
  • Clear and collaborative communication;
  • Focus on quality from the start;
  • Analytical ability for interpretation;
  • Adaptability to emerging AI tools.

title: Prospecção Comercial / Analista de Novos Negócios
description:
Buscamos um(a) parceiro(a) na área de prospecção e novos negócios para atuar na região Sudeste. Conhece alguém? Indique para nós.


Prospecção Comercial / Analista de Novos Negócios


A Nomad Nation é uma produtora audiovisual que cria conteúdo para marcas, agências e plataformas, com foco em qualidade criativa e eficiência de produção.

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa e comunicativa para atuar na prospecção de novos clientes e oportunidades comerciais na região SUDESTE.


Responsabilidades:

Mapear e identificar leads e potenciais clientes (agências, marcas, estúdios, etc.);

Atualizar e organizar contatos no CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot ou similar);

Realizar contatos iniciais via e-mail, LinkedIn e telefone;

Marcar reuniões para o time comercial ou de direção apresentar os projetos;

Apoiar a construção de listas segmentadas e relatórios de prospecção.


Requisitos:

Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;

Organização e disciplina no uso de ferramentas digitais;

Interesse pelo mercado de publicidade, audiovisual e branded content;

Desejável experiência com prospecção, vendas B2B ou atendimento comercial.

(Diferencial) Conhecimento de CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot etc.)


Perfil ideal:

Pessoa curiosa, que gosta de conectar pessoas e marcas, entende o timing comercial e sabe manter follow-ups ativos com leveza e empatia.


Modalidade:

Remoto

trabalho remoto em horário comercial


Remuneração:

PJ + possíveis bônus por metas de reuniões qualificadas.

● Vivência em vendas complexas B2B e em negociação estratégica.

● Histórico comprovado de superação de metas e consistência em indicadores de performance.

● Domínio do ciclo completo de vendas de software.

● Resolução de problemas.

title: Analista de Atendimento Cliente | Sala VIP
description:
Sobre a Quero Passagem

Somos um marketplace digital de passagens e viagens com a missão de conectar pessoas a destinos de forma prática, segura e ágil em todo o Brasil. Inovamos constantemente para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes, estimulando a criatividade como motor de transformação no setor de turismo.


A Oportunidade

Já pensou em fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico, que conecta milhares de pessoas ao redor do país? Estamos em busca de um Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para atuar na nossa Sala VIP , localizada no Terminal Rodoviário Tietê, em São Paulo. Aqui, você será o rosto da Quero Passagem para os nossos viajantes, oferecendo acolhimento, suporte e uma experiência diferenciada antes do embarque. Se você gosta de gente, tem brilho no olhar e paixão por atendimento, queremos te conhecer!


O que você fará?

  • Recepcionar e acolher os clientes da Sala VIP, garantindo um atendimento cortês, empático e eficiente;
  • Fornecer informações detalhadas sobre o funcionamento da Sala VIP , serviços disponíveis, horário de embarque e facilidades locais;
  • Oferecer suporte em dúvidas relacionadas a passagens, remarcações e embarques , buscando sempre soluções ágeis e assertivas;
  • Manter o ambiente organizado e agradável , zelando pela estética e conforto do espaço;
  • Gerenciar o estoque de snacks e bebidas , assegurando o abastecimento e a qualidade dos itens oferecidos;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras áreas da empresa para garantir uma comunicação clara e um atendimento alinhado com os valores da Quero Passagem ;
  • Ter atenção especial a passageiros com necessidades especiais, demonstrando sensibilidade e preparo para oferecer um atendimento acessível.

title: Product Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Joom Pulse is a data platform that provides analytics and recommendations for marketplace sellers. Its features allow you to review the most profitable products, know the estimated profit of buying directly from the supplier, discover the categories with the greatest growth potential, and explore profitable ways to expand your business. Joom Pulse helps make e-commerce data easy to understand and efficient for all sellers.


Joom Pulse is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international group of e-commerce companies that was founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom also includes the following businesses: Joom Marketplace, a platform for shopping from all over the world; Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany, and JoomPro, a platform for cross-border wholesale trade. Joom’s offices are located in Latvia, China, Hong Kong, the USA, Germany, Brazil, and Portugal. Joom Group has its HQ in Lisbon, Portugal.


We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success Specialist to foster strong client relationships, enhance user satisfaction, and support seamless product adoption and retention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring alignment with customer needs
  • Provide fast & full answers to clients’ questions and support for their problems
  • Keep customers informed on new features and best practices to enhance usage
  • Monitor customer engagement and satisfaction to identify upsell and renewal opportunities
  • Lead renewal processes and identify growth opportunities within customer accounts
  • Ensure high retention rate by providing excellent customer success service & support


Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in customer success management
  • Fluency in Portuguese
  • Advanced communication skills with ability to handle difficult client conversations, build client trust and understand client perspectives
  • Ability to collect, structure, and filter clients’ feedback, and transfer this to the stakeholders as marketing manager, product manager, and other internal teams
  • Hands-on experience with customer retention and nurturing relationships with small and medium businesses
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven approach
  • Practical use experience of AI tools and quick software learning ability
  • Experience working based on KPIs (SLA, CSAT, Retention, Churn, Refunds) and results-oriented execution


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency and
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or analytical tools’ company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • 100% paid sick leave
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 47748
description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.


Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, Youtube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

title: Closer Consultivo SaaS/Agente de IA
description:
Pessoa de vendas consultivas B2B para transformar demanda de inbound e outbound (nutrida pela SDR), tráfego pago/orgânico e parcerias em receita recorrente . Conduz conversas no WhatsApp, realiza discovery , apresentações focadas em valor no Google Meet e fecha com transparência.


Como terá sucesso no cargo

  • Conduz discovery objetivo (dor, impacto, prioridade) e propõe solução enxuta e viável.
  • Realiza demonstrações direcionadas ao caso do cliente, com narrativa de valor clara.
  • Mantém higiene de pipeline no CRM e follow-ups consistentes.
  • Trabalha bem com SDR/Marketing/Parcerias e faz handoff limpo para Implantação/CS.

Como o cargo se encaixa na organização

Atua em conjunto com Marketing/SDR (IA + humano) , Parcerias e Implantação/CS , sendo responsável por converter oportunidades qualificadas em contratos de assinatura e setups iniciais.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir conversas no WhatsApp, incluindo Call e Meet de demontração da ferramenta, com leads de IA, tráfego e parceiros; priorizar oportunidades.
  • Discovery consultivo (contexto, processo, stakeholders, critérios de decisão, orçamento/risco).
  • Demonstrações no Google Meet (vendas, cobrança/inadimplência, contratos digitais, integrações bancárias, agentes de IA).
  • Elaboração de propostas objetivas e negociação ética até o fechamento.
  • Gestão de pipeline : registro no CRM, previsão e comunicação clara com as áreas envolvidas.
  • Aprendizado contínuo : trazer feedbacks de mercado para Produto e Parcerias.

Qualificações

  • Experiência em Account Executive / Inside Sales / Consultative Sales em B2B (SaaS ou serviços).
  • Habilidade de descoberta de valor (BANT/SPIN/MEDDICC ou equivalente) e condução de reuniões remotas.
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, organização e disciplina de CRM .
  • Curiosidade por automação e agentes de IA ; conforto em explicar soluções de forma simples.
  • Disponibilidade remota (carga flexível, preferência manhã).

title: React Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 3+ years of professional experience as a Front-End Developer • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, HTML, and CSS, with a focus on refactoring and component modifications • Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) for developing server-side components and supporting legacy UI development


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Solid understanding of ADA and accessibility standards • Experience with GitHub workflows, including pull requests


Job Description


You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing the team on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG accessibility improvements before moving to the next. This role is fully front-end, where you’ll develop and refine ReactJS, HTML, and CSS components, ensure compliance with accessibility standards, and support legacy UI by working with JSPs or similar technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with product, UX, and engineering teams to implement pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against VPAT, and document improvements. Daily responsibilities include participating in standups, using GitHub workflows for pull requests and code reviews, and proactively surfacing risks or blockers. You’ll also help modernize UI components while maintaining legacy systems, all while tracking progress toward accessibility goals.

title: Tech Lead FullStack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Tech Lead para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem, mas muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades

  • Capacidade de liderar e mentorar equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e excelência;
  • Habilidade de realizar tomada de decisão técnica estratégica, considerando requisitos de negócio e restrições de prazo;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada;
  • Contribuir em discussões de Design e Produto para garantir a melhor experiência do usuário e resultados de negócio;
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade para lidar com grandes volumes de dados e requisições.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend(Node) e Frontend(React);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de sistemas utilizando Typescript;
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes);
  • Experiência em cloud providers (AWS) e conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation);
  • Experiência em CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, etc.) e DevOps (monitoramento, logging, observabilidade);
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).


Desejável

  • Conhecimento ou vivência em Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus) é considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência em ambientes SaaS.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios.
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem, mas muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades

  • Capacidade de liderar e mentorar equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e excelência;
  • Habilidade de realizar tomada de decisão técnica estratégica, considerando requisitos de negócio e restrições de prazo;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada;
  • Contribuir em discussões de Design e Produto para garantir a melhor experiência do usuário e resultados de negócio;
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade para lidar com grandes volumes de dados e requisições.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend(Node) e Frontend(React);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de sistemas utilizando Typescript;
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes);
  • Experiência em cloud providers (AWS) e conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation);
  • Experiência em CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, etc.) e DevOps (monitoramento, logging, observabilidade);
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).


Desejável

  • Conhecimento ou vivência em Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus) é considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência em ambientes SaaS.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios.
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você atua na Liderança de times de desenvolvimento FullStack e tem boa experiência em desenvolvimento de software e liderança e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, preencha o formulário:

title: Editor de Video Motion - Pleno
description:
Editor Motion Pleno - VSL


Estamos com 1 vaga disponível para edição de VSL Pleno

Contratação: PJ / CLT

Salario Inicial: USD (dólares) + bonificação (Aproximadamente R$6000)


Se você sabe cumprir prazos, trabalhar sob pressão, é proativo, responsável e quer essa vaga, preencha o formulário abaixo:


Principais Atribuições:  Como Editor de Vídeo você irá fazer parte da nossa equipe de edição, onde nosso objetivo é desenvolver vídeos criativos, produzindo materiais inovadores para diferentes plataformas de divulgação. Suas responsabilidades incluirão, mas não se limitarão a:


  • Editar vídeos com precisão e ritmo adequado para VSLs e outros formatos de divulgação.
  • Criar vídeos dinâmicos com foco em performance, aplicando storytelling e elementos visuais persuasivos.
  • Aplicar e aprimorar processos internos de edição, contribuindo para a padronização e eficiência do fluxo de trabalho.
  • Explorar e testar novas ferramentas de inteligência artificial voltadas à edição e automação, compartilhando aprendizados com o time.
  • Apoiar em tarefas operacionais como download e organização de materiais, preenchimento de planilhas e manutenção de pastas.
  • Realizar pesquisas visuais e técnicas para inspirar e elevar o nível dos materiais produzidos.
  • Apoiar na contratação de atores virtuais e gestão de avatares, seguindo processos definidos.
  • Colaborar com o time em um ambiente dinâmico, orientado a resultados e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com edição de vídeos;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de edição de vídeo (Adobe Premiere, After Effects ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência com edição de VSLs, incluindo projetos complexos e com uso de motion graphics.
  • Conhecimento em IAs como ElevenLabs, DreamFace e Moises;
  • Familiaridade para encontrar footages que se adequem com a Copy elaborada;
  • Noções de design gráfico, motion e narrativa audiovisual;
  • Equipamento adequado para seguir com a prestação de serviços com a edição de vídeos longos;
  • Boa comunicação, organização, proatividade e criatividade;
  • Criar animações, vídeos em motion graphics e peças audiovisuais para campanhas de social media, marketing institucional e promocional; 

• • Produzir conteúdos criativos e dinâmicos para diferentes formatos (feed, stories, reels, shorts, YouTube e apresentações);

title: Bilingual Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description

LAB Tech Analytics is a dynamic and forward-thinking company dedicated to revolutionizing data-driven solutions. We empower businesses to unlock the true potential of their data assets through our comprehensive suite of services. From data recruitment and training to cutting-edge data products and services, we provide end-to-end solutions for every stage of the data lifecycle. Our expert team delivers actionable insights, advanced analytics, robust data infrastructure, and strategic guidance. Partner with LAB Tech Analytics to drive success in the data-driven era.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Bilingual Executive Assistant. The Executive Assistant will be responsible for managing schedules, organizing meetings, handling correspondence, preparing reports, and supporting day-to-day operations. The role also involves coordinating with teams, managing travel arrangements, and maintaining confidential records.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in English and another language
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Experience with scheduling, email management, and report preparation
  • Proficiency with office software and virtual meeting platforms
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
  • Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in executive assistant roles is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Communications, or related field is preferred

title: Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 47748
description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.


Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, Youtube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

title: Analista de Banco de Dados - foco em BI (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e só em 2021, foram +50 bancos utilizando nossa wallet digital e sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões Cof (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Banco de Dados (BI) - Pleno para se unir ao nosso Time de DATA para:

  • Desenvolvimento de dashboards claros e intuitivos, facilitando a tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Comunicação de insights e resultados de análises de forma clara e objetiva;
  • Realização de análises exploratórias e estruturadas para gerar insights relevantes, identificação de tendências, oportunidades e riscos que impulsionem o aprimoramento contínuo dos produtos;
  • Mapeamento das necessidades, definição de indicadores-chave (KPIs) e transformação de dados em informações relevantes para o acompanhamento de resultados;
  • Estruturação de processos de reporte envio de dados para públicos internos e externos.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Matemática, Ciências Exatas ou Engenharias;
  • Experiência com linguagem Python para análise e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência com linguagem SQL;
  • Experiência com construção de dashboards e relatórios em ferramenta PowerBI.
  • Experiência com Consumo de APIs;
  • Experiência com Modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência com Extração e manipulação de dados.

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e produtos SaaS B2B.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol em nível intermediário ou superior;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Pluxe Cuida – Programa de Assistência à Pessoa Colaboradora;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

  • Trabalhar com ferramentas, como: Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Functions e Cloud Run, AgentSpace, AgentEngine e arquiteturas AI-multiagent.


Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter:

  • Background em desenvolvimento de sistemas em Python;
  • Experiência com produtos do Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especialmente GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions e Vertex AI, ADK, AgentSpace, AgentEngine;
  • Conhecimento de práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas com o GitLab CI, Jenkins ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos A2A vs MCP, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Responsible AI, LLMs e Frameworks de IA (ex LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI);
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e microsserviços;

Será bacana se você também tiver:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas de IA Generativa;
  • Certificação em Google Cloud Platform (como Professional Machine Learning Engineer ou Data Engineer);
  • Familiaridade com MLOps, incluindo monitoramento, retraining e rastreamento de modelos;
  • Experiência no uso de frameworks e plataformas de versionamento de modelos e experimentos, como MLflow ou similares.


Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial).

Como parte do time da PrimeUp você terá direito a:


  • Contratação CLT com remuneração compatível ao mercado;

  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Folga Anual Bônus;
  • Reembolso de Certificações;
  • PrimeUp Academy (rede de capacitação profissional);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Plano de academias;
  • Programa de Bem-Estar com auxílio psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico.

title: Program Manager
description:
Insight Global is sourcing for a Program Manager, to join a global consulting firm assisting on an Experience Layer project to evaluate headless CMS/DXP platforms and define targeted POC. The Program Manager will oversee day-to-day delivery across vendors and internal stakeholders, own the master plan and cadence for demos, deep dives, and POCs, as well as schedule and coordinate demos/workshops; prep agendas, success criteria, and follow-ups. The ideal candidate will have experience managing POC definitions (use cases, data sets, success metrics), and tracking outcomes/readouts. This position will have high visibility, experience preparing and delivering executive-level status updates is a must. This position will be fully remote, sitting in LATAM working EST hours.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

-5–7+ years program/project management for enterprise SaaS platform selections (CMS/DXP or adjacent: Martech, CDP, DAM).

-Experience creating project plans, managing & tracking POC definitions, and analyzing project data

-Experience supporting projects or programs in the business applications, system implementation, or enterprise engineering space.

-Experience own the master plan and cadence for demos, deep dives, and POCs; keep deliverables on track.

-Comfortable working across engineering, security, procurement, and business stakeholders.

-Demonstrated operational rigor (roadmaps, RAID, OKRs/metrics) and strong written communication.


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

-Nice to have: familiarity with headless architectures, API-first platforms, analytics/RUM, and composable stacks

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About us:


Smarter Contact is the #1 messaging platform for real estate professionals in the U.S. Our SaaS product powers millions of conversations to close more deals through smart SMS, voice, and automation.


We’re a fast-growing SaaS company, leading the market and scaling fast — and we’re looking for a seasoned Full Stack engineer to join our high-performance team and build impactful features across our product suite.


If you're tired of slow, corporate environments and want to move fast, own decisions, and ship work that matters — this is your moment.


What You’ll Own:

  • Design and build high-impact features across our Node, Typescript, and ReactJS stack
  • Architect scalable systems and lead technical decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to connect product ideas to execution
  • Take ownership of user experience, performance, and system design
  • Dive into complex user journeys and translate them into clean, scalable code
  • Build for scale using GCP, PostgreSQL, and microservice-based architecture
  • Proactively identify technical gaps, raise flags, and propose improvements
  • Help maintain a high-quality codebase while shipping fast

title: Venture Analyst
description:
About Flow Capital

Flow Capital Corp. is a publicly listed provider of flexible growth and alternative capital solutions dedicated to supporting market-leading, high-growth companies. Since 2018, we’ve helped businesses in the US, UK, and Canada access financing that drives growth while minimizing dilution and retaining founder control. Our focus is on revenue-generating, VC-backed, and founder-owned companies seeking growth capital. Learn more at 



Overview


We’re looking for an entry-level analyst to join our venture team at Flow Capital. This role sits between our Marketing and Originations teams, starting with a focus on marketing. You’ll support a wide range of activities, including identifying and researching potential investment opportunities and supporting business development, while also contributing to marketing campaigns, content creation, and brand initiatives.

This is an excellent entry point for someone interested in gaining exposure to the venture ecosystem.


  • Location: Remote. Candidates must be available to work North American Eastern Time (GMT-4).
  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Proof of fluency will be required.
  • Please submit your resume in English only.



Responsibilities

  • Conduct research to identify potential investment and partner opportunities.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis (e.g., market sizing, competitive analysis, web analytics data).
  • Support lead generation and outbound email campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with marketing to create content, marketing materials and assist with digital initiatives as needed.
  • Track and analyze performance, providing insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Participate in events, webinars, and other initiatives to build Flow Capital’s brand.
  • Manage and update CRM records.



Qualifications

  • Business or a related field degree from a strong academic program.
  • A passion for early stage investing and a desire to be in the Venture Ecosystem.
  • Entry-level role. 0–2 years of experience in venture, business development, or finance preferred, but not required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn and take on new challenges. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive, versatile, and comfortable handling a variety of tasks across marketing functions
  • Familiarity with tools including AI tools, Webflow, HubSpot, Canva, outreach tools (e.g., Reply.io), PitchBook, SEMrush, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics.



Why Join Flow Capital?  

  • Be part of a leading Canadian venture debt firm working with high-growth companies.
  • Gain exposure to venture capital, finance, and growth-stage tech ecosystems.
  • Join a small, collaborative team where your work has a direct impact.



Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. Thank you for your interest.

title: Profissional Engenheiro(a) de Dados AWS | PySpark | Glue | ETL
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?
  • Desenvolver jobs ETL no AWS Glue para transformação entre camadas utilizando PySpark
  • Implementar camadas Bronze, Prata e Ouro no Amazon S3
  • Configurar Glue Crawlers e Data Catalog para as camadas Prata e Ouro
  • Realizar orquestração de processos com Step Functions e EventBridge
  • Configurar Kinesis Data Streams e Kinesis Firehose para ingestão em tempo real
  • Criar e otimizar consultas analíticas com Amazon Athena
  • Executar testes de performance e validação de formatos de dados para integração com aplicações
  • Automatizar infraestrutura e deploy utilizando GitHub e Terraform
  • (Desejável) Experiência em criação de dashboards no Amazon QuickSight

⚙️ Desafio técnico

O profissional atuará diretamente na criação de pipelines de transformação de dados , compreendendo os requisitos de negócio e implementando jobs de transformação no Glue com PySpark .

Os datasets resultantes serão persistidos nas camadas Raw, Silver e Gold no S3, com orquestração automatizada via Step Functions e infraestrutura versionada em Git e Terraform .

Stack principal: AWS Glue | PySpark | S3 | Step Functions | EventBridge | Athena | Kinesis | Terraform | GitHub


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Desenvolver jobs ETL no AWS Glue para transformação entre camadas utilizando PySpark

  • Realizar orquestração de processos com Step Functions e EventBridge
  • Configurar Kinesis Data Streams e Kinesis Firehose para ingestão em tempo real
  • Criar e otimizar consultas analíticas com Amazon Athena
  • Executar testes de performance e validação de formatos de dados para integração com aplicações
  • Automatizar infraestrutura e deploy utilizando GitHub e Terraform

O profissional atuará diretamente na criação de pipelines de transformação de dados , compreendendo os requisitos de negócio e implementando jobs de transformação no Glue com PySpark .

Os datasets resultantes serão persistidos nas camadas Raw, Silver e Gold no S3, com orquestração automatizada via Step Functions e infraestrutura versionada em Git e Terraform .

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams — and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter — highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual — to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must ; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

Your duties will span A/R, A/P, GL, Sales Tax, Payroll, and financial statement generation. You'll have the opportunity to grow, incorporating cash management, budgeting, and forecasting activities within a fast-growing, high-tech oil and gas software provider.

No two days are the same; you'll never stop learning and growing. You'll have the autonomy to make important decisions about systems and processes while receiving support and guidance along the way. You bring your intelligence, creativity, and curiosity; we'll teach you the rest.

title: Assistente de produção
description:
O estúdio Geiko Games, criador de títulos adultos de sucesso com milhões de downloads, está em fase de expansão e busca um(a) Assistente de Produção apaixonado(a) e com alto potencial para trabalhar diretamente com o Diretor Criativo e absorver conhecimento específico da área. Esta não é uma vaga comum; é uma oportunidade de mentoria direta e formação intensiva, trabalhando lado a lado com o responsável no desenvolvimento de nossas propriedades intelectuais.


A vaga oferece grande potencial de crescimento. Nosso objetivo é treinar alguém que internalize a visão e os processos para que possa ocupar cargo de gerência no futuro.


O que você fará:


  • Colaborar em todas as fases da produção dos jogos, do rascunho ao marketing, em um processo de adaptação mentorado.
  • Aprender a operar softwares de ponta da indústria (renderização 3D, edição de imagem, etc.) em um ambiente de produção ágil, com feedback e iteração em busca da excelência.
  • Receberá feedback direto e tarefas apontadas pelo diretor, com foco na execução com excelência da visão criativa.


O Perfil que Buscamos (Necessário):


  • Hardware: Setup pessoal (PC/Notebook) capaz de rodar softwares gráficos de alta demanda (Placa de vídeo com 4GB+, 6GB preferível).
  • Flexibilidade e Vontade de Crescer: Capacidade de transitar por diversas áreas do conhecimento, com foco na visão e na qualidade, com interesse de crescer na empresa.
  • Coachability (Capacidade de ser Treinado(a)): Uma fome genuína por aprendizado e uma postura altamente receptiva a feedback direto e construtivo. Buscamos alguém que veja a crítica como uma ferramenta natural do processo de crescimento e adaptação.
  • Experiência: Nenhuma experiência profissional prévia em game dev é necessária. Valorizamos o potencial e a vontade de ser moldado(a) por um processo de mentoria de alto nível de uma área de trabalho específica e rara no Brasil.


Diferenciais:


  • Inglês (leitura/escrita) para pesquisa e comunicação.
  • Intimidade com o ecossistema de PCs, softwares e jogos indie.
  • Paixão demonstrável por storytelling, jogos narrativos e cultura pop.

title: Account Executive/Sales Representative
description:
Company Description

Wyzer Staffing empowers law firms and attorneys by connecting them world-class virtual legal talent. By offering flexible, scalable virtual staffing solutions, we help legal professionals focus on serving clients and growing their practices.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Account Executive/Sales Representative. In this role, you will have meetings with attorneys to identify their needs and build relationships, generate and qualify leads, manage client accounts, and meet sales targets. You will conduct client presentations and video calls, negotiate contracts, and provide ongoing client support.


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in sales, lead generation, and account management
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proficiency in CRM software and sales tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting
  • Experience in the legal industry is a plus


We offer competitive pay, bonuses, and vacation and holidays, as well as a supportive and growth-oriented team environment. We look forward to hearing from you!
